title: Family looking for information after fatal hit-and-run crash - NewsBreak
text: FORT WAYNE, Ind. (WANE) — One local family is calling out for help and information as Fort Wayne police continue to investigate a hit-and-run crash that left one person dead. The Allen County Coroner’s Office identified Michael Tarail Bright, 48, on Tuesday as the victim of the crash, but police have not released the description of the vehicle involved in the crash at this time. WANE 15 spoke with his daughter, Natasjah Bright, who has been asking for help since the incident. “It would mean so much to us to figure out who did it; it would take a big weight off all of our shoulders,” she said. “Because the way we had to see him, it was just terrible, tragic, and that’s not okay.” Natasjah, one of Michael’s three children, described him as full of love, her support system, and a man who valued family. Without him, she said, “I’m not going to act like my life is just going to go back to normal, because it’s not”, and expressed how bad this is hurting her and her family. “To leave him like that, like he didn’t have family, like he wasn’t loved by anybody, nobody that was pure would’ve done that,” she said. She urged people to come forward if they have any information about the crash. People can submit information to the Fort Wayne Police Department on the non-emergency line at 260-427-1222, contact Crime Stoppers at 260.436.7867, or submit tips via the P3 app available at P3Tips.com. For the latest news, weather, sports, and streaming video, head to WANE 15.
